---
name: Jira Duplicate Audit
description: "Run the multi-agent duplicate audit for a Jira project."
argument-hint: "Jira project key, for example PROJ"
agent: "Jira Duplicate Demo"
---

Run `audit_jira_duplicates` for the supplied Jira project key. Ask for the key
if it is missing. Summarize the status, coverage, limitations, and findings;
do not claim the audit changed Jira.
